facts.text: Sam is struggling with weight and feels it is affecting their confidence and motivation.

evidence.quote: I'm struggling with my weight and it's affecting my confidence. I feel like I can't overcome all the challenges with my weight, I keep lacking motivation.

facts.text: Sam used to love hiking but has not had the chance to do it recently.

evidence.quote: I used to love hiking, but it's been a while since I had the chance to do it.

facts.text: Evan encourages Sam to believe in themselves and take things one day at a time, emphasizing that their worth is not defined by their weight.

evidence.quote: It's important to believe in yourself and take it one day at a time, Sam. Your worth is not defined by your weight.

facts.text: Sam acknowledges Evan's support and expresses difficulty in breaking out of their comfort zone.

evidence.quote: Cheers, Evan. Appreciate the help. It's tough breaking out of my comfort zone.
